about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - Beginner Box - Syrinscape Sound Link Pack

Syrinscape Sound Link Packs for Fantasy Grounds work with your Syrinscape Super Syrin subscription to provide you context-specific sounds for monsters and NPCs in the Pathfinder 2 RPG - Beginner Box (not included).

Syrinscape Sound Link Packs for Fantasy Grounds work with your Syrinscape Super Syrin subscription to provide you with context-specific sounds for monsters and NPCs in the Pathfinder 2 RPG - Bestiary 2 (not included).  The collection of Sound Sets can be created for free within the Fantasy Grounds Unity sound interface, but this pack has done all the work for you to link the monsters.  Appropriate sounds from Syrinscape will show up automatically in your Sound Context Window when you open an NPC.

This pack includes sound sets separated into the following categories:

  • Moods

  • Music

  • Elements

  • SFX

  • One-shots

These sound sets contain links to Syrinscape sounds only and this pack does not grant you access to any sounds you don't already own on Syrinscape.
